units.source_text: 可一旦想到這種本性說不定也是人類活下去的手段之一，我便對自己徹底絕望。

en.t: But once I thought that this nature, too, might be one of the means by which human beings survive, I fell into utter despair over myself.

units.source_text: 對於人類，我總是恐懼地顫抖。

en.t: Toward human beings, I was always trembling with fear.

units.source_text: 而對於自己身為人類一員的言行也毫無自信。

en.t: And I had no confidence at all in my own words and actions as a member of humanity.

units.source_text: 我總是將自己的懊惱密藏在心中的小盒裡，

en.t: I always hid my private anguish away in a little box inside my heart,

units.source_text: 一味地掩藏起自己的憂鬱和敏感，偽裝成天真無邪的樂天派，

en.t: constantly concealing my melancholy and sensitivity, pretending to be an innocent optimist,

units.source_text: 漸漸地把自己塑造成一個搞笑的怪胎。

en.t: and little by little I shaped myself into a comic oddity.

units.source_text: 怎麼樣都行，只要能把人們逗笑。

en.t: Anything was fine, as long as I could make people laugh.

units.source_text: 這樣一來，即使我置身於人們所謂的生活之外，

en.t: In that way, even if I stood outside what people called life,

units.source_text: 也不會引起他們的注意。

en.t: they would not pay much attention to it.

units.source_text: 總之，我不能成為阻擋他們視線的障礙。

en.t: In any case, I must not become an obstacle blocking their line of sight.
I was nothing, I was wind, I was sky.
